infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Homezy Partner uses your location to receive nearby job requests and navigate to customers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Homezy Partner tracks your location while on duty so customers can see your live arrival status.

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Homezy Partner accesses your photo library so you can upload existing document scans and trade certificates.
